svg.text: cyDNA Ecosystem - Its Own Domain with Its Own Umbrella
"Emotet infection detected on Finance user workstation"
• Malware DNA: 98% match to Emotet (from cyDNA)
• Arrived via: Phishing email at 10:23 AM (from email gateway)
• User: john.doe, Finance Dept (from AD + asset DB)
Key Differences: cyDNA Universe vs SIEM Universe
File DNA, code structure, behavior patterns
"File is 98% genetically similar to WannaCry family"
"User john.doe logged in from NYC and Moscow in 5 min"
"Finance user accessed unusual data + external transfer"
→ WHERE it is, WHO is affected,
HOW it got in, WHAT's the impact
ANSWER: cyDNA is Its Own Domain with Its Own Umbrella
cyDNA is NOT a subset of SIEM - it's a parallel security universe!
cyDNA discovers and classifies the threat
SIEM correlates and provides enterprise context
Together they answer: WHAT it is + WHERE/WHO/HOW
